# Pre-Meeting Briefing: OpenAI

## Recent Developments

OpenAI has experienced a dense and transformative period leading up to mid-November 2026, characterized by major product rollouts, architectural upgrades, administrative updates, and escalating cybersecurity and safety frameworks. 

### Model and Ecosystem Updates
In the software and infrastructure space, OpenAI released multiple updates to Codex in November 2026. Version 0.169.0 added terminal side-chat tabs, task search, custom model provider setup, and expanded Cloud conversation controls, alongside transcript improvements and sandboxing fixes ([Releasebot, 2026](https://releasebot.io/updates/openai)). Furthermore, Codex version 0.167.2 introduced incremental tool updates by default on Google Cloud Vertex AI ([Releasebot, 2026](https://releasebot.io/updates/openai)). 

ChatGPT introduced several feature enhancements in early November 2026, including **Images 2.6**, a faster image generation model designed to better preserve details during edits, alongside GIF creation and saved reference images for reuse across chats ([Releasebot, 2026](https://releasebot.io/updates/openai)). OpenAI also announced that it will retire Advanced and Standard Voice on December 11, 2026, shifting focus entirely to **GPT-Live**, which has seen voice usage nearly double since its introduction ([Releasebot, 2026](https://releasebot.io/updates/openai)).

### Agentic Commerce and Business Tools
OpenAI rolled out **ChatGPT Wallet** for eligible US Pro subscribers aged 18 and older. This feature allows an AI "dot" to execute purchases on behalf of users after biometric approval, substituting actual card details with a secure credential during agent-assisted checkouts ([Releasebot, 2026](https://releasebot.io/updates/openai)). 

For commercial users, OpenAI launched **Business Hub** in ChatGPT. Following identity verification via Persona, eligible US businesses can claim their presence, connect product feeds, view customer metrics, and build customer-facing AI agents ([Releasebot, 2026](https://releasebot.io/updates/openai)). Additionally, ChatGPT Business and Enterprise/EDU tiers introduced admin console email updates for non-SCIM users, streamlining user migration between verified domains within the same tenant ([Releasebot, 2026](https://releasebot.io/updates/openai)).

### Cybersecurity, Safety, and Compliance
OpenAI's safety and preparedness measures have intensified following preliminary evidence that upcoming models like *Astra* may cross Critical cybersecurity capability thresholds ([OpenAI, 2026](https://openai.com/index/pacing-model-development-cyber-capabilities)). To counteract risks, OpenAI expanded its **Daybreak** security program. This includes a $1 billion Daybreak for Frontline Defenders grant program, the creation of *Daybreak Red for Critical Infrastructure* for authorized testing, and the deployment of *Daybreak Blue* and *Daybreak Red* to assist verified defenders and researchers with vulnerability validation and patch development using models like *GPT-6 Cyber* ([Releasebot, 2026](https://releasebot.io/updates/openai)). Conversely, the older `gpt-5.5-cyber-preview` model has been deprecated and scheduled for API removal on February 1, 2027 ([Releasebot, 2026](https://releasebot.io/updates/openai)).
